0022600202.text: The Miami Heat (3-6, 2-3 on the road) visit the Sacramento Kings (1-8, 0-4 at home) for Miami's 10th game of the season. Miami sits third in the Southeast, 2.5 games back, and ninth in the East, while Sacramento is 15th in the West and on a two-game losing streak. Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (out, Achilles surgery), De'Andre Hunter (out, illness), Keegan Murray (out, ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (out, dislocated knee), and the teams have not yet met this season after splitting their 2025-26 series 1-1. The last meeting was on January 20, 2026, in Sacramento, when the Heat won 130-117.
